_doc: Beat sheet v12 (01/11, feedback from Hoa on Pumpkin): PHONE STATIC at the centre of the frame for the whole clip, no pan/zoom/shake/tilt, just one straight cut to the end card (big phone on the right, text on the left). Recording render/promo/v12/screen.mp4 (FILM0 2.2; + brighter grainy reflections, rain splashing on lit tubes; + grainy reflections on asphalt, wet wall base + contact shadow; end card logo flicker synced to audio; demo clock waits for 45 smooth frames; promo background rain (rain_bg); + rain hitting the wet ground with splashes, ground reflection without ripple distortion; + afterglow on switch-off; POLISH: sharp reflections, volumetric tube shadows, frosted glass when off, shadows fade when lit, glass streak slides on tilt, hot white halo; + post.ts haze fix (o no longer washed out); POLISH milestone 3 + rain beading/dripping on tubes + colour fix on colour change; with POLISH milestones 1–2, falling rain, LiveTrail chalk trail, neon/argon gas; sign already lit before t=0) (Release, TIMESCALE 0.5 compressed to 60 fps, 60/60 frames per second). Demo script v3 (src/demo/script.ts): first frame shows the 'hello' sign already lit; draw heart 0.45–~1.5 (blockout join), heart strikes ~2.0; tap heart 2.85 → palette pops up → red 3.3; tap text 4.1 → cyan 4.55; tilt 5.3–7.9; 'o' broken 6.9; switch off 8.6; switch on 9.75 (shared flash 9.80 = sync point); fully lit ~10.75.
